# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# CPTAC dataset analysis 

## Load data 

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)

# Set the path to the parent directory containing all sample folders
parent_dir <- "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/download/raw/"

# Get all the tsv files in nested folders
tsv_files <- list.files(parent_dir, pattern = "\\.rna_seq.augmented_star_gene_counts.tsv$", 
                        recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize lists to store assay data
assays_list <- list(
  unstranded = list(),
  stranded_first = list(),
  stranded_second = list(),
  tpm_unstranded = list(),
  fpkm_unstranded = list(),
  fpkm_uq_unstranded = list()
)

# Initialize for row (gene) data and sample names
row_data <- NULL
sample_ids <- c()

for (file in tsv_files) {
  sample_id <- basename(dirname(file))
  sample_ids <- c(sample_ids, sample_id)

  df <- read_tsv(file, col_types = cols(), skip = 1) %>% 
    dplyr::select(
      gene_name, gene_type, 
      unstranded, stranded_first, stranded_second,
      tpm_unstranded, fpkm_unstranded, fpkm_uq_unstranded
    ) %>% filter(!is.na(gene_name))

  if (is.null(row_data)) {
    row_data <- df %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, gene_type)
  }

  assays_list$unstranded[[sample_id]] <- df$unstranded
  assays_list$stranded_first[[sample_id]] <- df$stranded_first
  assays_list$stranded_second[[sample_id]] <- df$stranded_second
  assays_list$tpm_unstranded[[sample_id]] <- df$tpm_unstranded
  assays_list$fpkm_unstranded[[sample_id]] <- df$fpkm_unstranded
  assays_list$fpkm_uq_unstranded[[sample_id]] <- df$fpkm_uq_unstranded
}

# Convert lists to matrices and ensure correct row/column order
create_matrix <- function(data_list) {
  do.call(cbind, data_list) %>% 
    `colnames<-`(names(data_list)) %>% 
    `rownames<-`(row_data$gene_name)
}

se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(
    unstranded = create_matrix(assays_list$unstranded),
    stranded_first = create_matrix(assays_list$stranded_first),
    stranded_second = create_matrix(assays_list$stranded_second),
    tpm_unstranded = create_matrix(assays_list$tpm_unstranded),
    fpkm_unstranded = create_matrix(assays_list$fpkm_unstranded),
    fpkm_uq_unstranded = create_matrix(assays_list$fpkm_uq_unstranded)
  ),
  rowData = row_data,
  colData = DataFrame(sample_id = sample_ids, row.names = sample_ids)
)
```


## Add metadata

```{r}
CPTAC_meta <- as.data.frame(read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/CPTAC/CPTAC_meta_clean.xlsx"))
sample_sheet_id <- read_delim("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/download/gdc_sample_sheet.2025-05-19.tsv")
```


```{r}
se$Case_ID <- sample_sheet_id$`Case ID`[match(se$sample_id, sample_sheet_id$`File ID`)]
se$Case_ID <- str_split(se$Case_ID, ",", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Filter cases for which we have metadata
se <- se[,se$Case_ID %in% CPTAC_meta$Case_ID]
```


```{r}
for (entry in colnames(CPTAC_meta)){
  colData(se)[,entry] <- CPTAC_meta[, entry][match(colData(se)[,"Case_ID"],CPTAC_meta$Case_ID)]
}

check <- colData(se) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(Case_ID) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
```

### Summarize assays per patient 

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(matrixStats)

# Extract patient identifiers
patient_ids <- colData(se)[, "Case_ID"]

# Function to summarize the assays by patient ID using median
summarize_assay_by_pid <- function(assay_matrix, patient_ids) {
  unique_pids <- unique(patient_ids)
  summarized_matrix <- sapply(unique_pids, function(pid) {
    rowMedians(as.matrix(assay_matrix[, patient_ids == pid]), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  colnames(summarized_matrix) <- unique_pids
  return(summarized_matrix)
}

# Summarize each assay in the SummarizedExperiment
assay_list <- lapply(assays(se), summarize_assay_by_pid, patient_ids)

# Summarize colData
colData_new <- colData(se) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(-sample_id, -Specimen_ID, -Slide_ID) %>% unique()
colData_new$PID <- colData_new$Case_ID
rownames(colData_new) <- colData_new$PID

assay_list_rounded <- lapply(assay_list, function(x) round(x))

# Create a new SummarizedExperiment object with summarized assays and colData
new_se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = assay_list_rounded,
  rowData = rowData(se),
  colData = colData_new
)

new_se

### QC 
## Patient with five samples - should only be partly TRUE
summary(assay(new_se, "unstranded")[,"C3N-01200"] == assay(se, "unstranded")[,"167073fa-9e38-4f8d-af1f-301ed3a8b5f7"])

## Patinet with one sample - should be TRUE
summary(assay(new_se, "unstranded")[,"C3L-00004"] == assay(se, "unstranded")[,"406ce387-c5b5-461a-a178-bc8cb402aade"])
```

```{r}
CPTAC.clean <- new_se

CPTAC.clean$status_DFS
CPTAC.clean$status_OS <- as.numeric(CPTAC.clean$status_OS)
CPTAC.clean$OS_days <- as.numeric(CPTAC.clean$OS_days)
CPTAC.clean$DFS_days <- as.numeric(CPTAC.clean$DFS_days)
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact 
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(CPTAC.clean) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, DFS_days, status_DFS, OS_days, status_OS, ISUP_combined, pT_combined) %>% unique()

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ ISUP_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          palette = unname(metadata(CPTAC.clean)$colors$ISUP_combined),
          ggtheme = theme_classic())

#Plot survival curves
fit_1 <- survfit(Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ pT_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit_1)

ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv",
          palette = unname(metadata(CPTAC.clean)$colors$pT_combined),
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          
)

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(DFS_days, status_DFS) ~ ISUP_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          palette = unname(metadata(CPTAC.clean)$colors$ISUP_combined),
          ggtheme = theme_classic())

#Plot survival curves
fit_1 <- survfit(Surv(DFS_days, status_DFS) ~ pT_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit_1)

ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv",
          palette = unname(metadata(CPTAC.clean)$colors$pT_combined),
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          
)

```


## DESeq2 processing

### CPTAC - full dataset 

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

# Create DESeqDataset
ddsSE <- DESeqDataSet(CPTAC.clean, design = ~ 1) #no design specified - not performing differential expression now
ddsSE

# DESeq analysis includes count normalization based on size factors
res <- DESeq(ddsSE)
rownames(res) <- rowData(res)$gene_name
counts_norm <- counts(res, normalized = TRUE) # Access normalized counts 

# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(res)

# Access normalized and stabilized counts
mat <- assay(vsd)
```

### Save

```{r}
saveRDS(res, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_res_nodesign.rds")
saveRDS(vsd, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_vsd_nodesign.rds")
saveRDS(CPTAC.clean,"/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_cleaned.rds")


res <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_res_nodesign.rds")
vsd <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_vsd_nodesign.rds")
CPTAC.clean <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/validation/CPTAC/CPTAC_cleaned.rds")
```
